full.name: get_farm
full.description: The farm record, its herds, and the decision settings.

full.name: list_paddocks
full.description: Every paddock: id, name, status, area in hectares, GeoJSON geometry, notes, last grazed.

full.name: get_herd
full.description: A herd: species, count, animal units, autonomy, the paddock it is in (and how we know), and its collars.

herd_id.description: Herd id. Optional when the farm has one herd.

full.name: get_herd_positions
full.description: Latest fix and fence state for each collar in the herd.

herd_id.description: Herd id. Optional when the farm has one herd.

full.name: get_boundary_status
full.description: The herd's active and staged boundaries, any proposal waiting on the farmer, each collar's latest ack, and the move: the target the herd is being swept into (status sweeping, done or stopped; step; remaining_m from the back line to the target; stragglers dropped from the sweep).

herd_id.description: Herd id. Optional when the farm has one herd.

full.name: get_signals
full.description: Grazing signals per paddock: rest days, grazing pressure from collars, forage and recovery from imagery, feed budget, weather risk, cue pressure.

herd_id.description: Herd id. Optional when the farm has one herd.

full.name: get_land_report
full.description: Land report for a paddock: weather history and forecast, imagery, climate, water. Unavailable sections say why. Cached for six hours.

refresh.description: Fetch fresh instead of using a report under six hours old.

full.name: search_knowledge
full.description: Search grazing principles and this farm's own lessons. Ask about the specific situation, e.g. "residual before heavy rain".

full.name: list_decisions
full.description: Recent decisions, newest first, with status, reasoning, the farmer's response and outcome.

full.name: run_sql
full.description: Read-only SQL over fixes, cues, acks, boundaries, decisions, collars, animals, paddocks, herds. Times: `t` is unix ms.

full.name: propose_boundary
full.description: Propose moving a herd: a paddock, a GeoJSON Polygon boundary, or both, with plain reasons. Recorded as a decision; the herd's autonomy decides whether it waits for the farmer, runs on a timer, or goes to the collars now.

herd_id.description: Herd id. Optional when the farm has one herd.

to_paddock_id.description: Paddock to move to. Its shape is the boundary unless geometry is given.

reasoning.description: Two to four short lines, each a reason tied to a fact.
